name.zh: 绥芬河—满洲里高速公路

tagline.en: Russian border to Russian border: from Suifenhe across Harbin, the Songnen plain and the Greater Khingan to Manzhouli
tagline.zh: 从俄罗斯边境到俄罗斯边境：自绥芬河经哈尔滨、松嫩平原，翻越大兴安岭抵满洲里

start.en: Manzhouli road border crossing, Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, facing Zabaykalsk in Russia — kilometre 1,437
start.zh: 内蒙古自治区呼伦贝尔市满洲里公路口岸，对面为俄罗斯后贝加尔斯克口岸——1,437 公里处

end.en: Suifenhe road border crossing, Heilongjiang, facing Pogranichny in Russia — kilometre 0
end.zh: 黑龙江省绥芬河市绥芬河公路口岸，对面为俄罗斯波格拉尼奇内口岸——零公里点

en: G10 is the northernmost of the mainland's east–west expressways, 1,437 km on the national chainage between two land crossings into Russia. From Suifenhe it runs west through Muling and Mudanjiang, through the hills by Hengdaohezi, Yabuli and Shangzhi to Harbin, then across the Songnen plain by Zhaodong, Anda, Daqing and Qiqihar to Gannan and the Inner Mongolia line. In Hulunbuir it climbs the Greater Khingan by Arong Banner and Boketu, comes down to Yakeshi and Hailar, and crosses the grassland to Zhalainuo'er and Manzhouli.

Heilongjiang has 880 km of it and Inner Mongolia 557. It shares about 15 km with G11 at Mudanjiang and runs on the Harbin ring expressway round the south, west and north of the city. For most of its length it parallels China National Highway 301, the older road between the same two border towns. Manzhouli is China's largest land port; local government presented the road above all as a trade route to Russia and Mongolia.
zh: G10 是中国大陆最北的一条东西向高速公路，按国家里程桩号全长 1,437 公里，两端都是通往俄罗斯的陆路口岸。它自绥芬河向西，经穆棱、牡丹江，穿过山区，经横道河子、亚布力、尚志抵哈尔滨；再横穿松嫩平原，经肇东、安达、大庆、齐齐哈尔至甘南，进入内蒙古。在呼伦贝尔境内，它经阿荣旗、博克图翻越大兴安岭，下到牙克石、海拉尔，再穿过草原，经扎赉诺尔抵满洲里。
黑龙江段 880 公里，内蒙古段 557 公里。它在牡丹江与 G11 鹤大高速共线约 15 公里，在哈尔滨经绕城高速绕行城南、城西和城北。全线大部分与 301 国道并行——那是连接这两座边境城市的旧公路。满洲里是我国最大的陆路口岸，沿线地方政府首先把这条路定位为通往俄罗斯、蒙古的贸易通道。

en: It is a four-lane road throughout, mostly on a 26-metre roadbed for 100 km/h. Heilongjiang's first expressway, Harbin–Daqing, began in 1991 as one carriageway of a planned dual road; it was widened to full width from 1996. Harbin–Mudanjiang, 299 km, was rebuilt to expressway standard on top of a second-class road opened in 1997.

The 296 km from Arong Banner over Boketu to Yakeshi, begun in 2008, was described when work started as Inner Mongolia's longest, most expensive, highest-latitude and most difficult road project since 2006, crossing farmland, forest, wetland and high-cold permafrost in the Greater Khingan. On the last section, west of Hailar, the line crosses the Erka wetland, which straddles the border with Russia. The original design put the road across it on embankment; after review by experts the region paid nearly 1 billion yuan more to carry 13.9 km on bridges, four of them new, and the wetland section was the last piece to open.
zh: 全线为双向四车道，大部分路段路基宽 26 米，设计时速 100 公里。黑龙江省第一条高速公路哈大段 1991 年先按高速公路半幅建成，1996 年起扩建为全幅。哈尔滨至牡丹江段 299 公里，是在 1997 年建成的二级公路基础上改扩建为高速公路的。

2008 年开工的阿荣旗经博克图至牙克石段 296 公里，开工时被称为「十一五」以来内蒙古里程最长、投资最大、地理纬度最高、地形最复杂、施工难度最大的公路项目，途经农田、草原、林区、湿地，穿越大兴安岭高寒多年冻土地带。最后一段海拉尔以西，路线穿过中俄共有的跨国湿地——二卡湿地。原设计以路基穿越；经专家多轮论证，自治区追加近 10 亿元，把 13.9 公里湿地段全部「路改桥」，新建大桥 4 座。湿地段也是全线最后开通的一段。

en: Suifenhe–Manzhouli was one of the seven east–west lines of the 1992 'five verticals and seven horizontals' trunk plan, numbered 015. The first piece was Harbin–Daqing, opened as a half-width road in October 1991. Harbin–Mudanjiang followed in September 2007, and in 2009 Heilongjiang began a three-year push on its expressways: Daqing–Qiqihar and the main works of Qiqihar–Gannan opened on 29 September 2010, and Mudanjiang–Suifenhe, begun on 1 May 2009, on 25 September 2011, finishing the Heilongjiang section.

In Inner Mongolia, Arong Banner–Boketu, the first expressway in Hulunbuir, was through in late October 2011; Boketu–Yakeshi opened in October 2012 and Yakeshi–Hailar on 3 November 2013. West of Hailar the road stayed a first-class highway for another decade. The Hailar–Manzhouli expressway was approved in 2016 and begun in July 2018; all but the Erka wetland was handed over in January 2022, and the wetland bridges opened on 10 December 2023, completing G10 and, with it, all eleven national expressway main lines in Inner Mongolia.
The road was numbered G10 in the national expressway plan of January 2005, the first of the eighteen east–west lines, which are numbered from north to south.
zh: 绥芬河至满洲里是 1992 年「五纵七横」国道主干线规划中的七条横线之一，编号 015。最早建成的是哈尔滨至大庆段，1991 年 10 月按半幅通车。哈尔滨至牡丹江段于 2007 年 9 月建成；2009 年黑龙江开展公路建设「三年决战」：大庆至齐齐哈尔段及齐甘段主体工程于 2010 年 9 月 29 日交工通车，2009 年 5 月 1 日开工的牡丹江至绥芬河段于 2011 年 9 月 25 日通车，黑龙江段至此全部建成。

内蒙古境内，阿荣旗至博克图段于 2011 年 10 月下旬贯通，是呼伦贝尔第一条高速公路；博克图至牙克石段 2012 年 10 月开通，牙克石至海拉尔段 2013 年 11 月 3 日通车。海拉尔以西此后十年仍是一级公路。海拉尔至满洲里高速公路 2016 年获工可批复，2018 年 7 月开工，2022 年 1 月除二卡湿地段外完成交工，湿地段桥梁于 2023 年 12 月 10 日通车，G10 全线贯通——内蒙古境内 11 条国家高速公路主线也随之全部建成。
2005 年 1 月公布的国家高速公路网规划将其编为 G10，即 18 条东西横线中的第一条（横线自北向南编号）。

en: No cost for the whole road has been published. The public figures are per project: 5.657 billion yuan budgeted for the 169 km Mudanjiang–Suifenhe section; 1.33 billion for Daqing–Qiqihar and 3.26 billion for Qiqihar–Gannan; 11.1 billion for Arong Banner–Boketu–Yakeshi, 296 km, of which 5.78 billion was for the 160 km to Boketu; 2.55 billion for Yakeshi–Hailar; and 6.161 billion for Hailar–Manzhouli, including the 0.9996 billion added for the wetland bridges.

The Inner Mongolia sections were paid for, in the words of one tender notice, from Ministry of Communications special funds, the region's own money and domestic bank loans. Like most mainland expressways the road is tolled; the first 14 km out of Suifenhe are free.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价，公开数字均为分段项目：牡丹江至绥芬河段 169 公里概算 56.57 亿元；大庆至齐齐哈尔段 13.3 亿元，齐齐哈尔至甘南段 32.6 亿元；阿荣旗经博克图至牙克石段 296 公里 111 亿元，其中至博克图的 160 公里 57.8 亿元；牙克石至海拉尔段 25.5 亿元；海拉尔至满洲里段 61.61 亿元，含为湿地「路改桥」新增的 9.996 亿元。
内蒙古各段的资金，按一份招标公告的说法，来自交通部专项资金、自治区自筹和国内银行贷款。与大陆大多数高速公路一样，它是收费公路；出绥芬河的头 14 公里免费通行。

en: Both ends are border posts, and the expressway runs to the crossings themselves. West of Hailar the main line is accompanied by a separate 226 km service road for local traffic, built with it.
zh: 两端都是边境口岸，高速公路一直通到口岸本身。海拉尔以西，主线旁同步修建了一条 226 公里的辅道，供地方交通使用。

why.en: No total has been published. G10 was built by Heilongjiang and Inner Mongolia as at least eight separately financed projects between 1991 and 2023, and costs are reported per project; sourced section figures are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G10 由黑龙江和内蒙古在 1991 至 2023 年间分至少八个项目分别筹资建设，造价按项目公布；下列为有来源的分段数字。

value.en: Mudanjiang–Suifenhe, 169 km: 5.657 billion yuan budgeted (2009–2011). Daqing–Qiqihar, 101 km: 1.33 billion; Qiqihar–Gannan, 101.7 km: 3.26 billion (both opened 2010).
value.zh: 牡丹江至绥芬河段 169 公里概算 56.57 亿元（2009—2011）；大庆至齐齐哈尔段 101 公里 13.3 亿元，齐齐哈尔至甘南段 101.7 公里 32.6 亿元（均 2010 年通车）。

figures.source: Northeast Net (dbw.cn), 12 April 2009 and 30 September 2010 (Hecheng Evening News)

value.en: Reported at 1.197 billion yuan for widening the 132.8 km half-width road to a full expressway, from May 1996, funded by a Ministry of Communications subsidy and provincial loans. From an encyclopedia entry only; not checked against an official source.
value.zh: 据报道，132.8 公里半幅路扩建为全幅高速公路总投资 11.97 亿元，1996 年 5 月开工，资金来自交通部补贴及省交通厅筹集贷款。仅见于百科条目，未与官方来源核对。

figures.source: Baidu Baike, 哈大高速公路

value.en: Arong Banner–Boketu–Yakeshi, 296.1 km: 11.1 billion yuan (begun 2008), of which Arong Banner–Boketu, 160 km: 5.78 billion. Yakeshi–Hailar, 76.3 km: 2.55 billion (2013). Hailar–Manzhouli, 188.68 km: 6.161 billion (2018–2023; China News Service gives 6.162 billion), including 0.9996 billion added for the Erka wetland bridges.
value.zh: 阿荣旗经博克图至牙克石段 296.1 公里 111 亿元（2008 年开工），其中阿荣旗至博克图段 160 公里 57.8 亿元；牙克石至海拉尔段 76.3 公里 25.5 亿元（2013）；海拉尔至满洲里段 188.68 公里 61.61 亿元（2018—2023；中新网作 61.62 亿元），含二卡湿地调整工程新增投资 9.996 亿元。

figures.source: China National Radio, 11 August 2008; Xinhua 08, 1 November 2011; Inner Mongolia News (nmgnews.com.cn), 8 November 2013, archived, and 11 December 2023 (Inner Mongolia Daily); Hulunbuir Municipal Government, 11 December 2023; China News Service (Inner Mongolia), 12 December 2023

value.en: Heilongjiang and Inner Mongolia, each for its own sections, repaid from tolls. For Boketu–Yakeshi the sources were Ministry of Communications special funds, the region's own funds and domestic bank loans. No foreign loan is recorded in the sources consulted.
value.zh: 黑龙江、内蒙古分别出资建设各自路段，以通行费还贷。博克图至牙克石段资金来自交通部专项资金、自治区自筹及国内银行贷款。所查来源中未见使用外国贷款的记载。

figures.source: Boketu–Yakeshi expressway project office, tender notice, March 2011, via flowerworld.cn; Chinese Wikipedia, 绥满高速公路

value.en: 1,437 km on the national chainage: 880 km in Heilongjiang, 557 km in Inner Mongolia
value.zh: 按国家里程桩号 1,437 公里：黑龙江 880 公里，内蒙古 557 公里

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 绥满高速公路

timeline.en: Harbin–Daqing, Heilongjiang's first expressway, opens in October as a half-width road.
timeline.zh: 10 月，黑龙江第一条高速公路哈大段按半幅建成运营。

timeline.en: The 'five verticals and seven horizontals' plan makes Suifenhe–Manzhouli trunk line 015.
timeline.zh: 「五纵七横」规划将绥芬河至满洲里列为 015 国道主干线。

timeline.en: The national expressway plan numbers it G10.
timeline.zh: 国家高速公路网规划将其编为 G10。
9 月 30 日，哈尔滨至牡丹江段建成通车。

timeline.en: Work on Arong Banner–Boketu–Yakeshi begins on 10 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 10 日，阿荣旗经博克图至牙克石段开工。

timeline.en: Daqing–Qiqihar and the main works of Qiqihar–Gannan open on 29 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 29 日，大齐段及齐甘段主体工程交工通车。

timeline.en: Mudanjiang–Suifenhe opens on 25 September; Arong Banner–Boketu is through by the end of October.
timeline.zh: 9 月 25 日牡丹江至绥芬河段通车；10 月下旬阿荣旗至博克图段贯通。
10 月，博克图至牙克石段开通。
11 月 3 日，牙克石至海拉尔段通车。

timeline.en: Work on Hailar–Manzhouli begins in July.
timeline.zh: 7 月，海拉尔至满洲里段开工。

timeline.en: The Erka wetland bridges open on 10 December, completing G10.
timeline.zh: 12 月 10 日，二卡湿地段通车，G10 全线贯通。
